objective: Deliver EduAI Phase 3 commerce through Marketplace, configurable memberships, PayOS QR settlement, advanced analytics, affiliate operations, and production release gates while preserving verified EduAI 2.0 learning and authorization behavior.

inScope: Completed Sprint 13 through Sprint 22 capabilities remain the verified product baseline.
Sprint 23 establishes commerce contracts, persistence, cart pricing, orders, and administrator operations.
Sprint 24 delivers versioned membership plans, dynamic durations and discounts, service entitlements, included courses, centralized access grants, renewal, plan changes, and removed-course grace.
Sprint 25 integrates PayOS VietQR requests, signed idempotent webhooks, atomic fulfillment, reconciliation, cancellation, expiry, and audited manual refunds.
Sprint 26 delivers authoritative revenue, membership, product, funnel, voucher, and entitlement-usage analytics.
Sprint 27 delivers referral attribution, auditable commission lifecycle, affiliate administration, dashboards, and manual withdrawal requests.
Sprint 28 validates migrations, accounting invariants, security, observability, accessibility, performance, cross-role UAT, deployment, and rollback.
outOfScope: Stored-value wallet, user cash balance, or wallet-to-wallet transfer.
Card storage, automatic recurring billing, installment payment, or split settlement.
Multiple active payment providers in the initial Phase 3 release.
Proration for mid-term membership upgrades or downgrades.
Rebuilding verified learning, Career Hub, mentor, notification, or AI flows without a factual integration requirement.

releaseCriteria: Every Phase 3 task has structured passing evidence for its required tests, deployment, and production verification before DONE.
PayOS callbacks are signature-verified, idempotent, amount-matched, order-matched, and never trusted from browser redirects.
Order prices, discounts, membership versions, durations, benefits, and line items are immutable snapshots.
Course and service access is centralized, preserves purchased rights and progress, and expires membership-derived rights correctly.
Orders, payments, refunds, analytics, affiliate commissions, and audit records reconcile without duplicate financial effects.
Backend/frontend builds, migrations, focused suites, cross-role UAT, security, observability, accessibility, performance, rollback, and production verification pass.
EduAI Phase 3 is verified at https://eduai.giaoducso.org.vn.

extensions.sourcePolicy: Human-authored source material is preserved; canonical execution state is maintained in .ai-dos/records.
